before.meaningEn: a crude block of metal (lead or iron) poured from a smelting furnace; live like a pig, in squalor

after.meaningEn: (n.) a farm animal with a broad snout, short legs, and a curly tail; a crude block of metal (lead or iron) poured from a smelting furnace; live like a pig, in squalor

patches.reason: 圖句、中文及既有例句皆使用動物 pig，但原英英解釋只有金屬錠與像豬般生活，漏掉核心動物義。補回已有中文的動物義，保留其他既有解釋，不改原句或圖片；整詞draft保留。
